title: Polynomial-Time Computability of the First Projection Composition
statement: The function on finite binary strings that first takes the second component of a string parsed as a self-delimiting pair, then takes the first component of that result, and then takes its first component again—using the empty string whenever a required parse fails—is polynomial-time computable.
